name: The Waystone
description: A mossy standing stone marks where the trail from Wrathrock splits among the Hollowfields. Someone has scratched arrows into it: MILL to the west, FIELDS to the east, and to the south, the lane. Beneath the last arrow, smaller and newer, someone has added: WOOD -- DON'T.

name: The Millpond
description: A broad, still pond backs up behind a mill whose wheel stopped turning a long time ago. The reeds along the bank are flattened into nests, and something in them is hissing at you. West, past the pond, the mill yard waits.

name: Along the Hedgerow
description: A tangled hedgerow of hawthorn and bramble runs north to south, taller than a man and full of rustling. Gaps have been chewed through it at ankle height.

name: Farm Lane
description: A rutted lane between low stone walls. The farms on either side have been left to themselves: gates hang open, and nobody answers when you call. The lane runs on south toward a bridge.

name: The Overgrown Orchard
description: Apple trees gone wild, their windfalls rotting in the grass and drawing every insect for a mile. A red barn stands at the southern end of the rows.

name: The Wheat Field
description: Wheat stands unharvested and gone to seed, head-high and whispering. Paths have been trampled through it by things much lower to the ground than you. A narrow track leads south, away from the farms.

name: The Red Barn
description: The barn's doors hang off their hinges. Inside, the hayloft sags and the stalls are empty of anything a farmer would want, and full of things a farmer wouldn't. It smells strongly of rat.

name: The Old Bridge
description: A humpbacked stone bridge crosses a slow brown stream. Past it to the south, the farmland gives up and the trees begin, dark and close together.

name: A Narrow Track
description: The track bends away from the fields into scrub. Bootprints, a cold pipe, a snapped arrow: somebody watches this path. Smoke rises from somewhere to the east.

name: The Bandit Camp
description: A ring of lean-tos around a smoky fire, with stolen sacks of grain stacked under a tarp. The people who live here did not invite you and are not pleased to see you.

name: The Edge of the Old Wood
description: Oaks older than Wrathrock close overhead, and the light goes green and dim. A woodcutter's path leads off to the west. To the south the trees grow thicker, and it is very quiet.

name: The Woodcutter's Clearing
description: Stumps and a half-finished woodpile, an axe rusted into a block. Whoever worked here left in a hurry. A thin path winds south between the trees, and it smells of woodsmoke and herbs.

name: The Hedge-Witch's Hollow
description: A turf-roofed hut sits in a hollow ringed with drying herbs, charms of bone and twine, and a garden that is much too green for the season. Whoever keeps it knows how to mend what the wood breaks.

name: The Deep Wood
description: The trees crowd so close that the sky is a rumor. There are tracks in the mud, big ones, and a smell of wet fur. Eastward the ground slopes down toward something huge lying across the path.

name: Beneath the Overturned Oak
description: An oak of enormous age has fallen here, and its roots have torn a hole out of the hillside. The hole goes down -- rough steps cut into the earth, older than the tree was. Cold air breathes up out of it, carrying the smell of stone and something long dead.
